body.input: Which energy companies opened an office in Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following energy companies opened an office in Finland in 2026:

1. **Energiequelle GmbH** — The German renewable energy company opened a second office in Finland, located in **Vaasa** on the west coast. This office complements its existing head office in Helsinki and focuses on project development, property security, and construction. Energiequelle has a pipeline of around 200 wind turbines in the Ostrobothnia region at various stages of development.

2. **WEG** — The Brazilian industrial equipment and energy solutions company opened a new sales office in **Pietarsaari**, Finland. The office provides customer support and tailored solutions including industrial motors, drives, variable frequency inverters (VFDs), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) to customers across Finland, strengthening WEG's Nordic operations.

These are the energy-sector office openings in Finland during 2026 that were identified in available sources.

explainability.content: Energiequelle GmbH opened a second office in Finland, located in Vaasa on the west coast, complementing its head office in Helsinki and focusing on project development, property security, and construction.
WEG opened a new sales office in Pietarsaari, Finland, providing customer support and tailored solutions such as industrial motors, drives, VFDs, and BESS, strengthening its Nordic operations.
Thus, the energy-sector companies that opened offices in Finland in 2026 are Energiequelle GmbH and WEG.

context.content: # Energiequelle continues to expand and opens a second office in Finland. © Energiequelle GmbH- Around 200 wind turbines are planned in the Ostrobothnia region. Vaasa (renewablepress) - The Finnish subsidiarysubsidiary of Energiequelle has opened a new office on the west coast of Finland. The office complements the head office in Helsinki and already employs four people in the areas of project development, property security and construction. Tore Regnell, Location Manager of the Energiequelle [...] Vaasa EnergyWeek in March, which brings together all players in the energy sector in Finland and beyond. Even before the opening of the new office, Energiequelle had already strengthened its presence in the Ostrobothnia region with various wind farm projects. The company currently has a pipeline of around 200 wind turbines in various stages of development. But Nils Borstelmann, Managing Director of Energiequelle Oy in Finland, is not only looking forward to enormous growth here: "Since entering [...] the Energiequelle office in Vaasa, is convinced by the location: "The proximity to the Vaasa University campus offers a major advantage, as this region has a wealth of experience and training opportunities in the energy sector. As a result, there is a large pool of potential employees in the region, which is of great interest to us as a growing company." The city of Vaasa has also been heavily involved in the renewable energy market in recent years, for example with the annual Vaasa EnergyWeek

document.name: Energiequelle continues to expand and opens a second office in Finland - Renewable Energy Industry

context.content: From motors and gear units to variable speed drives and automation technologies, WEG supplies solutions designed to improve energy efficiency, reduce maintenance requirements and support industrial resilience. The new Finnish office will also provide expertise in WEG's BESS solutions for industrial applications, helping companies stabilise power supply and manage peak loads as electrical demand and renewable generation grow. [...] Finland's industrial sector is undergoing significant transformation, with major investments across energy, manufacturing and automation. The country is recognised as a leader in renewable energy adoption and electrification, creating growing demand for high-efficiency motors, drives and energy storage solutions. [...] With the new sales office located in Pietarsaari, WEG will provide comprehensive customer support and tailored industrial motors, drives, variable frequency inverters (VFDs) and battery energy storage systems (BESS) to customers across Finland, strengthening its presence in an advanced industrial market.

document.name: WEG expands Nordic operations with new office in Finland
